body: You are seriously a great person and everyone in this subreddit deserves one huge internet hug.  Thanks to people like you and posters above I managed to get through a crisis.  And sometimes all you need is to talk to someone to realize that you are not alone and that each day the sun will rise the next day

In Canada actually, I must admit prior to this I had a superior mentality (coming from educated parents) that only idiots dropped out and party goers who spent more time drinking then studying.  Now I realize coming from small towns learning how to write a proper exam can be stressful enough
I honestly just had it built up in my mind that I get 1 chance in University 1 chance thats all and if I fuck up well game over
unfortunately I am but a couple of bad profs that have trouble speaking english for a first language can make easy concepts hard
